title: Crack the interview
tagline: Most-asked questions first, beginner to senior.
description: A focused path through the topics that come up in full stack interviews: JavaScript and TypeScript internals, React and Next.js, Node.js, databases, system design, DSA and behavioral rounds.

title: Full stack mastery
tagline: The complete path from HTML to production deploys.
description: Every track in build order: web basics, the frontend stack with Next.js, the backend stack with Node.js, SQL and NoSQL databases with Prisma and Drizzle, then Docker, CI/CD and testing.

title: Frontend specialist
tagline: Next.js, React and everything around them.
description: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, styling, state management, testing, performance and accessibility.

title: Backend and databases
tagline: Node.js, APIs, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, ORMs and Docker.
description: Node.js runtime internals, API design, authentication and security, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Drizzle, Redis, Docker and deployment.

title: Self development
tagline: Fundamentals that make you a better engineer.
description: How the web works, Git and the command line, data structures and algorithms, system design and the soft skills that move a career forward.

title: CA Foundation
tagline: All four Foundation papers, exam order.
description: Accounting, Business Laws, Quantitative Aptitude and Business Economics under the ICAI new scheme: concepts, worked problems, MCQ drills and descriptive answers.

title: CA Inter Group I
description: Advanced Accounting, Corporate and Other Laws, Income-tax (Income-tax Act 2025) and GST, with computations, case-based MCQs and theory answers.

title: CA Inter Group II
description: Cost and Management Accounting, Auditing and Ethics, Financial Management and Strategic Management.

title: CA Inter (both groups)
description: Both groups of CA Intermediate in study order: accounts and costing first, then law, tax, audit, FM and SM.

title: CA Final Group I
description: Financial Reporting (Ind AS), Advanced Financial Management and Advanced Auditing, Assurance and Professional Ethics.

title: CA Final Group II
tagline: Direct Tax, Indirect Tax and IBS.
description: Direct Tax Laws and International Taxation, Indirect Tax Laws (GST, customs, FTP) and Integrated Business Solutions case studies.

title: CA Final (both groups)
description: Both groups of CA Final, ending with the multidisciplinary IBS case studies.
